answer: Sybil resistance comes from EigenTrust-style reputation with exponential decay and a fixed temporal half-life: past contributions lose weight unless an identity sustains honest, reciprocal service. A freshly spawned account lacks trusted paths and therefore has near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot fabricate that history, leaving it unable to meet consensus thresholds. Whether called zenith, falcon, or copper, a node earns influence only through verified behavior.
